attack_prediction.protocol: nested leave-one-group-out over 37 Attack Flow source groups (36 evaluable); document weighting; macro mean over groups with 95% bootstrap CI

multistep_status.reach_impact_or_exfiltration_probability: NOT EVALUATED: beam search returns the most likely paths, whose summed probability is only a lower bound on the marginal probability of reaching a tactic; a calibrated estimate needs Monte Carlo rollouts or exact enumeration, deferred to a later milestone.
multistep_status.monte_carlo_rollouts: NOT IMPLEMENTED in Milestone 4 (deferred; see docs/LSTM.md).

detection.protocol: whole-day holdout: train Monday-Wednesday, test Thursday-Friday; fixed 0.5 threshold; primary detector pre-registered (random_forest); single run, no CIs

quantum.protocol: exact statevector simulation (NumPy, validated against qiskit 2.5.2); E2 5 seeds x N {100..2000} x d {4,6,8}, mean +/- 95% t-CI; E3 single seed; E4 single seed
quantum.conclusion: No quantum advantage was observed under the tested conditions.

integration.nature: SYNTHETIC demonstration (hand-authored scenario); NOT a real-world validated attack-chain evaluation

stored_m6_policy_check.note: Policy behaviour on real stored M5/M6 band outputs; no technique evidence exists for CIC flows (CIC labels are not ATT&CK techniques), so no disagreement can be corroborated. Not a performance metric.
